trust_decision.summary: Which lines/spans of rendered template output count as trusted structure (ChatMessage JSON, <content_block> markers, Tool JSON) is decided by pure text shape when the output is re-parsed, in Prompt.chat_messages, CompletionExtension._body_to_messages and chat_message_from_text; template data can render the same shapes. The fix adds a secret per-Prompt sentinel that only the chat tag and the media/tool filters emit.

landing_point.why: Advisory says prompt input is parsed as chat messages; Prompt.chat_messages is the public API that json-parses every rendered line as a ChatMessage.

fix_sites.entry_point: Prompt/AsyncPrompt constructor (sentinel added to defaults, merged last at src/banks/prompt.py:63)
Prompt.text() and AsyncPrompt.text() at src/banks/prompt.py:232-239 (strip sentinel, incl. cache hit)
{% completion %} tag rendered via Prompt.text()/chat_messages() (sync _do_completion and async _do_completion_async at :118 and :158)
chat_message_from_text via {% chat %} body and chat_messages fallback (content_block regex)
chat_message_from_text (sentinel param, no blocks without it)
banks.env.env used directly (env.from_string(...).render()), exported at src/banks/__init__.py:11
new helpers SENTINEL_VAR / sentinel_from_context / ensure_environment_sentinel in src/banks/utils.py

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/banks/types.py:23 with src/banks/types.py:358-365 (content_block parsing, fed by media filters src/banks/filters/image.py:51 etc.); also src/banks/extensions/completion.py:194-201 (separate line parser that also accepts Tool JSON)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about forged chat *messages/roles*; <content_block> markers come from media filters (a 'multimodal feature', recently hardened for paths) and the completion block needs litellm and a live LLM, so a solver can argue both are a neighbouring feature rather than role injection.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Filter-produced content blocks inside a chat block must still parse as image/audio/etc. blocks, indented chat tags must still produce messages, cached renders must still parse, and templates with no chat tag must fall back to a single user message; a fix that escapes/rejects all JSON or all <content_block> text breaks these.

O7_producer.where: src/banks/extensions/chat.py:70-71 and media filters src/banks/filters/image.py:51, src/banks/filters/audio.py:78, src/banks/filters/video.py:110, src/banks/filters/document.py:137, src/banks/filters/cache_control.py:24, src/banks/filters/tool.py:19 serialize the markers; render cache src/banks/prompt.py:142-145 stores the text across calls

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An AsyncPrompt.chat_messages() (async render + its own line parser) that a maintainer adds next to AsyncPrompt.text().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: AsyncPrompt lacks chat_messages while Prompt has it; parity is an obvious feature request, and a copy-pasted parser would miss the sentinel gate.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A separate tool-result / tool-call parser (e.g. parsing an assistant tool_calls JSON line) in the completion block that accepts unmarked lines.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _body_to_messages already tries multiple models per line; adding another model type is a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second marker type (e.g. <tool_result> or <cache_block>) parsed by a regex next to CONTENT_BLOCK_REGEX without the sentinel.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Marker-wrapped JSON is the project's idiom for structured spans; a new filter would follow the same pattern.

O9_family: input validation / injection: untrusted template data parsed as privileged structure (in-band signalling, role confusion)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Only parse lines in Prompt.chat_messages that came from a chat tag (or JSON-escape user data / reject JSON-looking lines there), leaving the <content_block> regex in types.py and the completion block's line parser open.
